episodeTitle.en: Inside OpenAI | Logan Kilpatrick (head of developer relations)

guestBioOfficial.en: Logan Kilpatrick leads developer relations at OpenAI, supporting developers building with the OpenAI API and ChatGPT. He is also on the board of directors at NumFOCUS, the nonprofit organization that supports open source projects like Jupyter, Pandas, NumPy, and more. Before OpenAI, Logan was a machine-learning engineer at Apple and advised NASA on open source policy. In our conversation, we discuss: • OpenAI’s fast-paced and innovative work environment
guestBioOfficial.zh: 洛根·基尔帕特里克（Logan Kilpatrick）在OpenAI负责开发者关系工作，支持开发者使用OpenAI API和ChatGPT进行开发。他同时也是非营利组织NumFOCUS的董事会成员，该组织支持Jupyter、Pandas、NumPy等开源项目。在加入OpenAI之前，洛根曾在苹果担任机器学习工程师，并为NASA提供开源政策咨询。在我们的对谈中，我们探讨了：• OpenAI快节奏且富有创新性的工作环境

title.en: Inside OpenAI | Logan Kilpatrick (head of developer relations)

summary.en: Logan says the top traits he looks for when hiring are high agency and urgency - people who act without needing consensus. He describes being on the front lines as developers figure out how to use AI superpowers in real products. The episode offers a window into OpenAI's developer ecosystem and what makes builders effective in the AI era.
summary.zh: 洛根说，他招聘时最看重的特质是高自驱力与紧迫感——即无需达成共识就能行动的人。他描述了自己身处一线的经历：开发者们正在弄清如何把 AI 的超能力用在真实产品中。本期让我们一窥 OpenAI 的开发者生态，以及在 AI 时代什么让构建者高效。
